info.title: API Reference
info.description: REST API for the telemedicine storefront. All public endpoints are unauthenticated. Patient and admin endpoints require a Sanctum Bearer token.

post.description:
Returns a plain-text Bearer token with `frontend:*` abilities. The token is shown
only once; the client must persist it. Subsequent logins issue a new token without
invalidating existing ones.
post.summary: Authenticate a user and issue a Sanctum token

post.description:
Deletes only the token used in this request. Other active tokens for the same user
remain valid. The client should clear its stored token after calling this endpoint.

get.description:
Returns a lightweight user object containing id, name, email, roles, and last login
timestamp. Requires a valid Sanctum Bearer token.

Returns a paginated list of published posts ordered by published_at descending.
Supports filtering by category slug, tag slug, featured flag, and title search.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.summary: Get a published blog post by slug

get.description: Returns all visible categories ordered by position then name, with a published post count.

get.summary: Get a visible blog category by slug

get.description:
Returns tags from the unified tag pool that are marked visible, ordered by name.
Tags are shared across blog, catalog, FAQ, and profiles.

Returns a lightweight list of published pages (no section content) ordered by title.
Cached; invalidated instantly when CMS content is saved.

Returns the page with all typed sections included.
Cached; invalidated instantly when CMS content is saved.
get.summary: Get a published CMS page by slug

get.description:
Lightweight index of menu names and slugs. Fetch a menu's items via
/api/v1/menus/{slug}. Cached; invalidated instantly on save.

Items link to internal entities by `{type, slug}` (the frontend owns
route patterns) or to direct URLs/anchors by `{type, url}`. Items whose
target is unpublished or deleted are omitted, as are disabled items.
Nested up to 3 levels via `children`. Cached; invalidated instantly on save.
get.summary: Get a menu by slug with its nested item tree

get.description:
Returns every fixed region (top_bar, header, pre_footer, footer,
sidebar_left, sidebar_right — all keys always present) with its ordered
items. Each item is `{kind: "section", section: {...}}` (same envelope
as page sections, including inlined media/catalog data) or
`{kind: "menu", menu: {name, slug, items: [...]}}`. Global blocks are
emitted as sections with a `global` reference. Fetch once per app load
alongside the page payload. Cached; invalidated instantly on save.

Returns the cart identified by the X-Cart-Token header, creating a new one if the
token is absent or expired. The response always includes the cart token so the
frontend can persist it for subsequent requests.

delete.description: Removes every item from the cart identified by X-Cart-Token. Returns the now-empty cart.
delete.summary: Clear all items from the cart

post.description:
Adds a product or package to the cart, optionally under one of its plans. Increments
quantity if the same item and plan already exist in the cart. Requires `type` and `id`;
`plan_id` is required for packages and optional for products (term plans — omit it for
a one-time buy-once purchase). The plan must belong to the item. Returns the updated cart.
post.summary: Add an item to the cart

patch.description:
Sets the quantity of the specified cart item. Passing `quantity=0` removes the item
from the cart entirely. Returns the updated cart state.

message.example: This item does not belong to your cart.

delete.description: Deletes the specified cart item and returns the updated cart.
delete.summary: Remove a single item from the cart

message.example: This item does not belong to your cart.

get.description:
Returns visible categories ordered by position then name. Pass `?tree=1` to receive
a nested tree with children embedded. Default returns a flat list with parent reference.
Includes parent reference and visible children ordered by position.
get.summary: Get a visible catalog category by slug

get.description: Returns a paginated list of published products with categories and tags.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by product name or subtitle.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Filter products with an effective price at or above this amount (USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Filter products with an effective price at or below this amount (USD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: position (default), name, -name, price, -price, newest, oldest.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description: Includes categories, tags, and any packages that contain this product along with their plans.
get.summary: Get a published catalog product by slug

get.description: Returns a paginated list of published packages with their plans, categories, and tags.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter by package name or subtitle.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Filter packages with at least one plan priced at or above this amount (USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Filter packages with at least one plan priced at or below this amount (USD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: position (default), name, -name, price, -price, newest, oldest.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description: Includes published plans, included products, categories, and tags.
get.summary: Get a published catalog package by slug

get.description:
Returns visible tags ordered by position then name. Tags are shared across catalog,
blog, FAQ, and profiles.

Returns the option lists a product-listing filter UI needs: categories,
classes, types, forms, and ingredients (each with published-product
counts), the price bounds across published products, and availability
counts. Facet values with zero published products are omitted.

Returns the gateway provider name, the public/publishable key required to
initialize the gateway's client-side tokenization SDK (Accept.js, Collect.js,
Stripe.js, Square Web Payments), and the environment so the frontend can
target the correct SDK URL and form endpoint.
get.summary: Get the active payment gateway configuration for the checkout frontend

message.const: No active payment gateway is configured.

post.description:
Submits the identified cart and lead to the configured checkout provider (prescribe-rx
or local gateway). Returns the order UUID and a checkout path for the frontend to load
the next step. Requires matching cart_ulid and lead_uuid from the same session.

message.const: Checkout could not be completed. Please try again.
payment_method is required for local checkout.

message.example: Cart and lead do not belong to the same session.

get.description:
Returns brand, theme, contact, SEO, and provider capability settings in a single
cached response. The React frontend calls this once on app boot. Cached for 5 minutes.

Returns published profiles ordered by position, with tags. Optionally filter by
profile type or restrict to featured profiles only.

Returns the published profile matching the slug with its tags. Returns 404 if not found
or not published.
get.summary: Get a published profile by slug

get.description:
Returns published FAQ items ordered by position. Optionally filter by category slug
or tag slug. Includes the item's category and tags.

Returns all visible FAQ categories ordered by position, each with their published
items (including tags) embedded.
get.summary: List FAQ categories with their published items

get.description:
Returns the visible FAQ category matching the slug, including its published items
with tags. Returns 404 if the category is not found or not visible.
get.summary: Get a single FAQ category with its published items

get.description:
Resolves the encounter type for the given product/package IDs and returns the
live intake schema from the telehealth provider. The frontend renders this schema
dynamically — no hardcoded form fields. Pass `products[]` and/or `packages[]` query
params with local integer IDs.
get.summary: Get the intake question schema for a set of products or packages

post.description:
Called when the user submits the first checkout step (name + email + cart).
The cart snapshot is passed in from the frontend's live cart state so the
backend Lead record captures what was selected at lead-capture time. Binds
the lead to the X-Cart-Token session when present.

get.description:
Used by the frontend to pre-fill checkout forms on return visits (e.g. the user
closes the tab and returns via a recovery email link). The UUID is treated as a
bearer credential — only share it with the lead owner.

Returns an order with its items, shipments, and fulfillment center. The UUID is
returned only at checkout completion and serves as a bearer credential for this
endpoint. Requires a valid Sanctum Bearer token.

post.description:
Creates a local patient record and attempts to link an existing PRX chart
if one is found for the supplied email. Returns the patient resource and
a Sanctum bearer token.
Returns a `patient:*`-scoped bearer token. The token is shown only once.
post.summary: Authenticate a patient and issue a Sanctum token

get.description:
PRX requires the patient token (not the sales-org token) for video room
access so the PHI audit log attributes the session to the patient.
get.summary: Retrieve a video-room token for an encounter

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation

get.description: Scheduling uses the sales-org token (not the patient token).

post.description: Injects the patient's PRX chart ID. Scheduling uses the sales-org token.

Accepts HMAC-SHA256 signed webhook payloads from Prescribe-Rx. The signature is
verified against the `PRESCRIBE_RX_WEBHOOK_SECRET` env variable. In non-production
environments without a secret configured, unsigned payloads are accepted. Returns
401 if the signature is invalid.
post.summary: Receive a Prescribe-Rx order or encounter status update

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
